propositions: An optional isolated adapter must mine Claude Code session transcripts via error-signature grep to reconstruct local environment and integration diagnostics history.

The adapter classifier must deterministically map error signatures (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, pip errors, git errors, etc.) to an enum of five categories without LLM calls, ensuring reproducibility and self-containment.
All emitted classified records must carry source='backfill_classified' and confidence='classified' labels to signal low confidence and segregate from authoritative structural data.
The core metrics command and registry must not import the transcript adapter, enforcing portability — verified by a source-level import scan of registry.py and metrics/__init__.py.

The backfill script and adapter must be exercised by unit tests that validate fixture transcript extraction, classification into the correct enum value, and correct JSON schema output without network or model calls.
